name: gta-vi-road-ep4-three-trailers
lines:
العرض الثاني في مايو 2025
حدّد موعد 26 مايو 2026

العرض الأول في ديسمبر 2023
أعاد السلسلة إلى Vice City
headline:
أكبر مفاجآت
عروض GTA VI
label: رسمي

reel_check.SOURCE: primary read in full: yes: Rockstar Newswire and rockstargames.com/VI: Trailer 1 4 Dec 2023 ('neon-soaked streets of Vice City', end card 'Coming 2025'); Trailer 2 6 May 2025 ('Coming May 26, 2026'); the later date 19 Nov 2026 (rockstargames.com/VI, read 11 Nov); Launch Trailer 15 Oct 2026
reel_check.SOURCE: not already posted: yes: no trailer-history Reel in the ledger
reel_check.ANGLE before lines: yes: hook the three trailers ranked by surprise; why now 5 days to launch; for players here the road to 19 Nov; payoff the first trailer had promised 2025
reel_check.STORY TYPE trailer or first look: yes: what each trailer brought, newest to oldest, the biggest surprise last
reel_check.STORY: spoken paragraph, subject before: yes: «أكبر مفاجآت عروض GTA VI. العرض الأخير في 15 أكتوبر. العرض الثاني في مايو 2025 حدّد موعد 26 مايو 2026، ثم تأجلت (اللعبة) إلى 19 نوفمبر. العرض الأول في ديسمبر 2023 أعاد السلسلة إلى Vice City، وكان موعدها حينها 2025. بعد 5 أيام ينتهي الانتظار.» No line opens on و
reel_check.STORY: release verbs: yes: تأجلت for the delay; no bare تصل
reel_check.STORY: names: yes: game and city names in English; no company named on screen beyond the credit
reel_check.SENSITIVE: yes, none: no weapons, injuries, drinking or explicit shots; the trailers' swimwear and club shots left out
reel_check.SOUND: footage sound or bed with reason: yes: Trailer 2 music stem from 117.3 s (music_only); no other episode uses this stretch
reel_check.PICTURE: footage first: yes: Rockstar's three trailers, each line on its own trailer
reel_check.PICTURE: not the same picture as the las: yes: picture: Jason and Lucia at the car (launch trailer 40.4); not in the last five

decision_log.shot: Trailer 1 cuts read frame by frame: 27.4 street ends 28.8 (nightclub from 29.0); 45.4 night lot ends 46.5 (a phone-video clip from 46.6); Trailer 2 opens on the highway (35.7) and the Keys from the air (6.6), the dock at 81.6 and the Launch Trailer car shot left out (director-level content and framing), tower from 50.8 after the title card; closing on Rockstar's Vice City sunset still
LT 40.4 the pair at the car; LT 33.3 boat
Trailer 2 master 50.0 tower (no title card), 83.3 sunset; Launch Trailer 7.0 Jason polishing a car under the delay line (v4 counter shot showed only his shoulder)
T1 3.6 highway, 61.0 the pair driving, 45.4 night lot, 70.4 red car
decision_log.alternatives: T1 40.5 VICE sign is episode 2's; T1 85.5 'Coming 2025' card cut by the 9:16 window, so the year is a line

decision_log.note: T1 13.3 beach and 21.3 flamingos are episode 2 stretches (series ledger)

note: Episode 4 of «الطريق إلى GTA VI» (studio order, Mohammad 11 Nov 2026).
block_ok: the crossfade from the stilt house (Trailer 2 8.55) into the sunset pier (Trailer 2 83.3, 0.25 s after the cut at 83.05): both IGN 3840 source stretches decode clean and read 1.32 to 1.39 on the block check; the flag reads the pier's long straight rails, horizon and string lights against the house; frames looked at 11 Nov 20:10Z, rendered stretch rechecked at 25 fps
